# awscc_ec2_application_status_check (Resource)

An application status check monitors an HTTP or HTTPS endpoint on Amazon EC2 instances and reports application-layer health. Configure a health check with a Protocol, Port, and Path, and then associate it with EC2 instances via AWS::EC2::ApplicationStatusCheckInstanceAssociation or AWS::EC2::ApplicationStatusCheckTagAssociation.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `port` (Number) The port used for the health check.
- `protocol` (String) The network protocol used for the health check.

### Optional

- `aggregation` (String) Whether this check is included in the rolled-up application status.
- `device_index` (Number) The network interface device index used for the health check.
- `failure_threshold` (Number) The number of consecutive failed probes required to mark the instance unhealthy.
- `health_check_paths` (Attributes List) The source/destination network paths used for the health check. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health_check_paths))
- `initialization_grace_period_seconds` (Number) Seconds to wait after instance launch before beginning health checks.
- `interval` (Number) The interval, in seconds, between health check probes.
- `ip_scope` (String) The IP scope used for the health check.
- `ip_version` (String) The IP version used for the health check.
- `path` (String) The HTTP path used for the health check.
- `status_code_matcher` (String) The HTTP status codes considered successful (e.g., "200-299").
- `success_threshold` (Number) The number of consecutive successful probes required to mark the instance healthy.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Tags to apply to the application status check. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `timeout` (Number) The timeout, in seconds, for each health check probe.

### Read-Only

- `application_status_check_id` (String) The unique identifier of the application status check.
- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the application status check.
- `creation_time` (String) When the application status check was created (ISO 8601).
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_ec2_application_status_check.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the application status check

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_ec2_application_status_check.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_ec2_application_status_check.example "arn"
```
